description: Bespoke local-Euler-factor builder for the automorphic-forms-adelic topic. A range slider over s combined with per-place toggle controls assembles partial Euler products place by place to display L(s, pi). The slider-plus-toggle-list-plus-product-readout layout is specific to assembling automorphic L-functions and does not fit parametric-plot.
